summary: Russian forces launched coordinated drone and missile strikes across Ukraine targeting energy infrastructure, including near Khmelnytskyi nuclear plant. Attacks damaged Zaporizhzhia steel plant and disrupted power grids nationwide. Ukraine's defense forces reported downing multiple Shahed drones and Geran-5 missiles.
key_points: Multiple Shahed drones and Geran-5 missiles targeted energy infrastructure across Ukraine, including near Khmelnytskyi nuclear plant. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/77135)
Russian forces attacked Zaporizhzhia with ballistic missiles, damaging residential buildings and industrial infrastructure at the Zaporizhzhia steel plant. (Source: @eRadarrua/124014)
Ukrainian forces destroyed a drone manufacturing facility in Russia's Rostov region to reduce drone supply to the front. (Source: @UkraineNow/84726)
Coordinated attacks hit Chernihiv, Kyiv, and other regions with Shahed-136 drones and Geran-2/3 missiles. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/77138)
Drone attacks damaged critical infrastructure in Luhansk, Kharkiv, and other eastern regions. (Source: @kpszsu/87713)
Russian missile strikes hit Lviv region, raising concerns about potential attacks on western Ukraine. (Source: @UkraineNow/84720)
Ukraine launched experimental drone delivery system for medical supplies and blood samples. (Source: @UkraineNow/84703)
Protests erupted in Kyiv over inadequate winter preparations and corruption in housing allocation. (Source: @UkraineNow/84718)

sections.executive_summary: Russian forces conducted large-scale drone and missile strikes across Ukraine, targeting energy infrastructure including near Khmelnytskyi nuclear plant. Attacks damaged Zaporizhzhia steel plant and disrupted power grids nationwide. Ukrainian forces reported intercepting multiple Shahed and Geran-type drones and missiles.

points: Drone attacks targeted energy infrastructure across multiple regions including Khmelnytskyi nuclear plant, with reports of projectiles passing within 2km of the facility. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/77133)
Ukrainian forces destroyed a drone manufacturing facility in Russia's Rostov region to reduce enemy drone supply to the front lines. (Source: @UkraineNow/84726)
Coordinated Shahed drone and Geran-5 missile attacks hit Chernihiv, Kyiv, and other regions, with multiple projectiles targeting residential areas and industrial sites. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/77138)

Drone attacks damaged critical infrastructure in Luhansk, Kharkiv, and other eastern regions, with reports of strike drones and reactive drones operating in various directions. (Source: @kpszsu/87713)
Ukraine launched experimental drone delivery system for medical supplies, blood samples, and donor organs through the Ministry of Health's Institute of Cardiology. (Source: @UkraineNow/84703)
Protests erupted in Kyiv demanding the resignation of Mayor Vitali Klitschko over inadequate winter preparations and corruption in housing allocation. (Source: @UkraineNow/84718)
Border delays with Poland reached up to 40 hours due to frequent air alerts affecting cross-border movement. (Source: @UkraineNow/84712)

sections.threat_assessment: Russian forces are escalating attacks on Ukraine's energy infrastructure, including targeting near nuclear facilities, which poses significant risks to civilian safety and grid stability. The use of massed drone and missile strikes suggests a strategy to degrade Ukraine's defensive capabilities and civilian resilience. Attacks on the Zaporizhzhia steel plant indicate targeting of strategic industrial assets. The deployment of Iskander-M ballistic missiles demonstrates access to advanced weaponry. Continued attacks on western regions raise concerns about potential escalation into NATO-member territories.
sections.regional_response: Slovakia and Hungary refused to finance €70 billion for Ukraine through the EU for 2027, complicating Ukraine's financial planning. Poland reported border delays of up to 40 hours due to frequent air alerts. Moldova detained two Ukrainian border guards for illegal border crossing, indicating ongoing tensions in border security. The US is exploring potential meetings between Zelenskyy and Putin, possibly at G20 or in the Middle East. Trump's refusal to implement Russia sanctions under the Magnitsky Act raises questions about US policy direction.
sections.intelligence_notes: Russian forces are employing coordinated multi-vector drone and missile attacks targeting critical infrastructure across Ukraine. The use of both Iranian-made Shahed drones and domestically produced Geran systems indicates reliance on imported and indigenous UAV technology. Attacks on nuclear facilities require heightened monitoring due to potential radiological risks. The destruction of the Rostov drone factory represents a significant Ukrainian intelligence and operational success. Border delays with Poland reaching 40 hours highlight the operational impact of sustained air alerts on civilian infrastructure.
